in_sanskrit.name: Bunty
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Small
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bunty एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘banta’ meaning ‘little, small’. In Hindu mythology, the name Bunty could be associated with Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, who is often referred to as the ‘Little Lord’ or ‘Baba Ganesh’.
